title: Insufficient Boundary Coverage for Zero and Negative Account Balances
description: Withdrawal validator tested only with positive values; zero and negative boundary conditions untested.

ground_truth.description: Insufficient boundary coverage: zero and negative balance edge cases lack unit test verification.
ground_truth.explanation: Allows negative withdrawal amounts (e.g. withdraw -100) to pass validation because zero boundary is untested.

expected_evidence.description: Boundary condition mutation survives test suite.
